data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. Before a workspace can be deleted, all active integrations (e.g., Slack, Jira, Zapier) linked to that specific workspace must be disconnected. Navigate to 'Workspace Settings > Integrations' for the affected workspace and disable/remove all listed integrations, then retry deletion. [T-2380] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
